moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT s.areacode AS a_code, CONCAT( 'ต.', c.tambonname, ' ', CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 7 THEN RIGHT(s.areacode, 1) WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 8 THEN RIGHT(s.areacode, 2) ELSE 'ไม่ระบุ' END ) AS a_name, SUM(s."A") AS A, SUM(s."S") AS S, SUM(s."M1") AS M1, SUM(s."M2") AS M2, SUM(s."F1") AS F1, SUM(s."F2") AS F2, SUM(s."F3") AS F3 FROM ctambon AS c INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} AS s ON SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) = c.tamboncodefull AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN chospital_regis AS h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE (h.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}}) AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND h.hoscode IN ( SELECT hoscode FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear = {{YEAR}} AND (splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} OR 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY s.areacode, a_name ORDER BY a_name;

tambon.label: ตำบล
